creatures.name: Flaskling
creatures.concept: A tiny unfinished shadow homunculus inside a travelling alchemist’s flask. The violet nucleus and bronze neck-ring survive in every evolution.

ability.name: Incomplete Soul
ability.text: Species trait: receives 50% of the final EXP it would normally receive, including participation, capture EXP and binocular sharing. A single 2× Warbond multiplier brings this to normal EXP. The penalty ends upon evolution; changing abilities cannot bypass it.

signature.name: Feeble Pulse
signature.text: Dark special attack · 25 power · 100% accuracy · 35 PP. Its only natural damaging move.

moves: Lv. 10: Cower — raise own Defence one stage.
No further natural moves before evolution; codex teaching is blocked while the soul is unfinished.

creatures.name: Vainglulus
creatures.concept: The original one-eyed Flaskling pilots a towering ink courtier from its visible chest flask. A sweeping formal tailcoat, white cravat and watching shadow ribbons embody Pride.

ability.name: Peerless Ego
ability.text: special damage rises by 20% while no combat stat is lowered. A stat drop removes the bonus until all lowered stages are cleared.

signature.name: Look Upon Me
signature.text: Psychic special attack · 85 power · 100% accuracy · 10 PP. Deals 20% extra damage if the user has no lowered combat stats.

creatures.name: Wrathulus
creatures.concept: The original one-eyed Flaskling pilots a six-armed ink swordsman from its visible chest flask. Oversized ember-edged blades, spare swords and crimson ink ribbons embody Wrath.

ability.name: Grievance
ability.text: after surviving a super-effective damaging hit, gain one Attack stage. At most once per attack, including multi-hit moves.

signature.name: Fury Unsealed
signature.text: Fire physical attack · 100 power · 100% accuracy · 10 PP. Lowers the user’s Defence by one stage after dealing damage.

creatures.name: Slothulus
creatures.concept: The original sleepy one-eyed Flaskling is visible inside the chest flask of its massive mossy stone body, beneath an almost motionless hourglass.

ability.name: Unhurried
ability.text: reduce direct damage taken by 20% while moving after the attacker. Residual damage is unchanged; no forced loafing turns.

signature.name: Burden of Ages
signature.text: Ground physical attack · 75 power · 100% accuracy · 10 PP. Lowers the target’s Speed one stage on a successful hit.

creatures.name: Gulomunc
creatures.concept: The original one-eyed Flaskling remains visible in a suspended flask above the green digestive void within its immense glass belly.

ability.name: Bottomless
ability.text: healing from draining attacks is 25% stronger. The existing healing multiplier and maximum HP still apply; it cannot revive or grant lives.

signature.name: Empty the Table
signature.text: Dark physical draining attack · 75 power · 100% accuracy · 10 PP. Restores HP equal to 50% of damage actually dealt before healing modifiers.

creatures.name: Scruffox
creatures.concept: A wiry street-sparring fox whose plain wraps and four-point clasp give no clue whether it will become a protector or an extortionist.

ability.name: Quick Study
ability.text: the first lowered combat stat in each battle is restored immediately to its previous stage. Once per battle.

signature.name: Practice Bout
signature.text: Fighting physical attack · 40 power · 100% accuracy · 30 PP. No secondary effect.

creatures.name: Arthox
creatures.concept: A mythic Romano-British fox war leader: bronze lamellar armour, purple cloak and a radiant leaf-shaped blade. Athletic rather than heavily shielded.

ability.name: Sovereign Charge
ability.text: the first successful damaging move after each entry deals 25% extra damage. Switching resets it; missed or blocked attacks do not spend it.

signature.name: Avalon Cleave
signature.text: Fairy physical attack · 90 power · 100% accuracy · 10 PP. No secondary effect; a dependable blade for the attack specialist.

creatures.name: Alfredox
creatures.concept: A fortress-builder fox whose interlocking gate shield and layered armour evoke Alfred’s defensive burhs. Low damage and speed keep it distinct from Arthox.

ability.name: Burhwall
ability.text: reduce super-effective damage received by 25%. Does not affect status or indirect damage.

signature.name: Hold the Burh
signature.text: Steel status move · 10 PP. Raise the user’s Defence and Special Defence by one stage and remove its lowered Speed stages; no healing.

creatures.name: Ronnifox
creatures.concept: A broad, rough-edged fox enforcer: heavy knuckles, boxer’s stance and torn pinstripe waistcoat. Deliberately stockier and less precise than Reggifox.

ability.name: Heavy Hands
ability.text: contact attacks deal 15% more damage but the user cannot gain evasion stages. Does not boost non-contact moves.

signature.name: Back-Alley Barrage
signature.text: Fighting physical attack · 40 power × 2 hits · 100% accuracy · 10 PP. Two contact hits, checked using the game’s existing multi-hit rules.

creatures.name: Reggifox
creatures.role: Dishonourable / psychic support and special attacker
creatures.concept: A composed psychic fox organiser with silver watch, signal cane and directing thought-tokens. Buffing, disruption and Psychic special attacks share its toolkit.

ability.name: The Fixer
ability.text: After a successful status move, prepare the next special attack to deal 30% more damage. The bonus cannot stack, is spent only when special damage is dealt, and is lost on switching. Works entirely in singles.

signature.name: Quiet Arrangement
signature.text: Psychic status move · 10 PP. Lower one opponent’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.
